When using the Force to probe [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] for [[Whiplash]] leader [[Thi Xon Yimmon]], [[Jax Pavan]], sensed the damping effect of a [[taozin amulet]]. This led Jax to realize aboard the shuttle was an '''Inquisitor'''. He quickly scanned the rest of the shuttle for Yimmon to no avail.<ref name="Last Jedi" />
